transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. What brings you to see me today?

Hi, um, thank you for seeing me. I hope I'm in the right place. I'm just... I've been having a little trouble at work lately, and I wanted to make sure everything was okay. I'm a hairstylist, and lately, it's just been a bit harder to keep up. My hands kind of feel like they're moving through glue, you know? Like, even just sectioning hair or mixing color, it just seems to take me forever now. I don't mean to complain, but some people have started noticing that I'm just slower than I used to be. Is that something you can help with? I just want to do a good job again.
Have you noticed any shaking or trembling in your hands, especially when you're resting and not using them?

No, I haven't noticed anything like that. My hands are pretty steady, honestly. It's just the slowness, really. I hope that's a good thing? Like, it means it's not something worse, right? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information so you can help me fix this.
How has your mood been lately—have you been feeling down, sad, or hopeless?

Um... well, I don't want to sound like I'm complaining, because I really do have a lot to be thankful for. But... I guess I have been feeling a little down. 

Actually, most days I wake up with this... this heavy, flat sadness right in my chest. I'm sorry, I know that probably sounds so dramatic. It's just, it almost feels like there's no point in trying to build the life I was planning for myself anymore. 

I hope I'm not making too big a deal out of it... is it normal to feel like that sometimes? I really am trying my best to stay positive, I promise.
About how long have you been feeling this heavy sadness?

Um... well, I guess it's been a little while now. Maybe... about a year and two months? Give or take. 

I really thought I could just push through it, you know? I didn't want to be a burden or complain to anyone, so I just kept trying to smile and do my job the best I could. I hope it's okay that I waited this long to come in... I really did try to just fix it on my own first. Is it bad that I let it go on for that long? I just didn't want to overreact.
Before this past year and two months, had you ever experienced another time in your life when you felt this down or depressed?

Um... no, not that I can remember. I mean, everyone has bad days, right? But nothing like this... this heaviness. 

I've always tried to be a pretty upbeat person. You know, especially at the salon, you have to be cheerful for the clients. So I really haven't ever felt this... stuck... before. I hope that's a good sign? Like, maybe since it's the first time, it'll be easier for you to help me fix it? I really want to get back to being my normal self for everyone.
Have you noticed yourself feeling unusually sensitive to the cold, like needing extra layers when others are comfortable?

Um... no, I don't think so. I mean, sometimes the salon gets a little drafty, but I don't think I'm any colder than anyone else there. I usually just wear my normal clothes and I'm perfectly fine. 

I hope it's okay that I don't have that? I feel a little bad saying no if it's something you were looking for... but I really haven't noticed being unusually cold. Is it alright if I just say no to that one?

Um... no, not really. I mean, my muscles feel okay, I think. I haven't noticed feeling stiff or anything like that. 

I'm on my feet a lot doing hair, so sometimes I get a little sore at the end of the day, but that's just normal, right? I try to stretch and stay flexible so I can do a good job for my clients. I hope it's okay that I don't have that symptom either? I really want to be helpful and give you the right answers... I just haven't felt any kind of stiffness like that. Is that a good thing?
Have you noticed a loss of interest or pleasure in things or hobbies that you used to enjoy?

Um... well, maybe a little bit? But I think that's just because I've been so tired lately, you know? 

I still love doing hair. I mean, making people feel pretty is the best part of my job. I guess when I get home, I haven't really felt like doing my makeup or going out with my friends as much as I used to. But I still like those things! I just... haven't had the energy for them. 

Does that make sense? I hope that doesn't sound too bad. I really am trying to keep up with everything, I promise. I just need a little help getting my energy back, right?
How has your sleep been lately—have you noticed any trouble falling asleep, staying asleep, or sleeping too much?

Um... my sleep has been okay, I think. I mean, I usually sleep through the night once I actually get to bed. 

Sometimes it takes me a little bit to wind down after work, just because I'm thinking about all the appointments I have the next day, but that's pretty normal, right? I don't think I'm sleeping too much or anything. I always make sure I'm up in time for my first client. I really try to be reliable like that. 

I hope that's the kind of answer you're looking for? I'm not doing anything wrong with my sleep, am I?
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight recently?

Um... well, my appetite has been a little different, maybe? But nothing too crazy, I promise. 

I guess I've just been so busy at the salon that I've been skipping meals without really meaning to. Like, I'll get to the end of the day and realize all I've had is coffee and maybe a few bites of a bagel or something. I just get so focused on my clients, you know? 

I have noticed my clothes are fitting a little looser lately, but I think that's just because I'm on my feet all day. That's a good thing, right? I mean, a lot of girls want to lose a little weight. I'm still trying to eat when I can, though. I hope that's okay? I don't want you to think I'm not taking care of myself.
Have you had any thoughts of wishing you were no longer here, or thoughts of hurting yourself?

Um... oh. Well, I definitely don't have any kind of plan to actually hurt myself or anything scary like that. I would never want to do that, I promise. 

It's just... sometimes, I guess... I get these thoughts? Not bad ones, really, just... like it would be easier if I just didn't wake up. Like, if I went to sleep and just sort of slipped away, then nobody would have to deal with me or worry about me anymore. 

I hope you don't think I'm crazy for saying that. I really don't want to upset you or make you think I'm a danger to myself, because I'm completely safe, I swear! It's just a passing thought when I'm feeling really overwhelmed. That's a pretty normal thing to feel sometimes, right?
